notes: New sources replaced the previous tiny OASST-only mixture. Auto balance retained all unique conversations without language downsampling (Russian primary by design). Old dataset kept under data/processed/oasst_ru_legacy/. New tokenizer must be trained before training: python scripts/train_tokenizer.py --data data/processed/oasst_ru/train.jsonl --out artifacts/tokenizer.json --vocab-size 16384.
